name: wp-ja-kinetic/current-term-name
title: Current term name
description: The currently-archived taxonomy term's raw name, no prefix — for a breadcrumb's dynamic last segment (`tag.html`). Not `wp:query-title` with `showPrefix:false`: that attribute does not stop core's `get_the_archive_title()` filter chain from running (verified live: `wp_ja_kinetic_tag_archive_title()`'s "Tagged: " prefix came through even with `showPrefix:false`), so a filter aimed at the H1 leaks into every other use of the block on the same page.
